ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Greedy Compression Using Rar.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects RAR usage that creates an archive from a suspicious folder, either a system folder or one of the folders often used by attackers for staging purposes

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\rar\\\.exe$") OR process_description = "Command\ line\ RAR") OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.exe\\ a\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ a\\ \\-m.*"))) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-hp.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-r\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ ?\\:\\\\\\*\\\..*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ ?\\:\\\\\\\\\\*\\\..*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ ?\\:\\\\\\$Recycle\\\.bin\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ ?\\:\\\\PerfLogs\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ ?\\:\\\\Temp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ ?\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ ?\\:\\\\Windows\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\%public\\%.*")))
